principal.name: Dr. Balaji Munde
principal.message: Welcome to Shri Nathuram Maharaj Mahavidyalaya. We are dedicated to providing excellent education with a focus on Civil Services (MPSC/UPSC) preparation and the traditional Kirtan Shastra.

about.intro: Located in Kehal Tanda, our college offers specialized B.A. programs designed for future civil servants and those interested in Maharashtra's rich Kirtan traditions.
about.vision: To empower students with the knowledge and values needed to excel in civil services and preserve cultural heritage.
about.mission: To impart high-quality education and training for competitive exams, fostering ethical leadership and academic excellence.

cta.title: Admissions Open
cta.subtitle: Join our specialized B.A. programs today and start your journey towards success. Scholarships available for ST, SC, VJNT, OBC & OPEN categories.
